name: Editorial Signal
purpose: Readable content with an authored typographic hierarchy.
unsuitable: Dense operational tables should use compact working surfaces.

recipes.composition: Offset title beside an index; long-form work below.
recipes.typography: Large serif title against compact sans labels
recipes.mobile: Index becomes a disclosure before a single reading column.
recipes.assetStrategy: User-owned project figure with explicit caption; otherwise labeled placeholder.

recipes.composition: Full-width masthead followed by numbered horizontal stories.
recipes.typography: Condensed sans masthead with serif reading text
recipes.mobile: Stories stack in source order; navigation wraps.
recipes.assetStrategy: Figures appear between stories, never replace semantic text.

states.loading: Preserve geometry; announce busy region without trapping focus.
states.empty: Explain why there is no content and offer a relevant next action.
states.error: Keep entered values; associate error text and expose retry.
states.success: Announce completion politely without moving focus.
states.focus: Visible 2px outline with offset, never clipped.
states.disabled: Use native disabled where applicable; explain unavailable actions.
states.menu: Native button with aria-expanded; Escape closes and restores trigger focus.

motion: No entrance animation; short color transitions, respect reduced motion.
accessibility: Preserve heading order and visible links.
source: Original project-authored recipes; no external assets.
